question: The Village and Small-Scale Industries Committee, passed in 1955, which noted the possibility of using small-scale industries for promoting rural development, is also known as ______.
solution:
The correct answer is "__**The Karve Committee**__". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Karve Committee**

 
 
• In** 1955**, a small-scale industrial committee was established.
 
• Another name for it was a** Karve committee**.
 
• It was given the name Dattatreya Gopal Karve in honor of the professor and economist from India who made significant contributions to public policy, cooperative movements, and economics.
 
• The Karve Committee was established in 1955 to promote the **development of small-scale companies**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kothari Commission**

 
 
• The Government of India established the National Education Commission, also known as the **Kothari Commission**, as an ad hoc commission with the mandate to review all facets of the Indian educational system, create a general framework for education, and suggest rules and policies for the advancement of education in the country. 
 
 
 
• **Abid Hussain Committee**
 
 
• On small-scale industries and Exim policy, the **Abid Hussain Committee** was appointed.
 
 
 
• **The Nayak Committee**
 
 
• The Reserve Bank of India established a Committee on** December 9 **under Deputy Governor Shri P.R. Nayank to investigate the challenges that small-scale industries (SSI) face while trying to secure financing.
